use_case_name: Display and Export System Information Logs

claims.content: The system shall display information logs and provide the capability to export the logs in common ASCII text for importing to commercial database, spreadsheet, or reporting programs.

goal.raw_text: The system shall display information logs and provide the capability to export the logs in common ASCII text for importing to commercial database, spreadsheet, or reporting programs.

claims.content: Operator
The Operator must be logged on to the RLCS.
The system shall have created and stored log files which track all system operations.
The Operator requests to view or export system information logs.

trigger.raw_text: The Operator requests to view or export system information logs.

claims.content: The Operator requests to display or export system information logs.
The system displays the requested log information on the GUI.
If the Operator chooses to export, the system provides the capability to export the logs in common ASCII text for importing to commercial database, spreadsheet, or reporting programs.
When the system administrator modifies the database tables, the GUI shall analyze the data before storing in the database and notify the system administrator of any conflicting or redundant entries.
The system information logs are displayed on the GUI.
If exported, the logs are available in common ASCII text format for importing to commercial database, spreadsheet, or reporting programs.
